Burnt Sienna in Oil vs. Watercolor — Key Insight
Burnt sienna (PBr7, calcined natural iron oxide) is chemically identical whether it appears in an oil paint tube or a watercolor pan, yet it produces markedly different optical effects, drying behaviors, and handling characteristics in each medium.

Open a tube of Winsor & Newton burnt sienna oil color and a pan of the same manufacturer's watercolor, and you are looking at the same calcined iron oxide.
